policy.description: All dashboard aggregations (mean, count, std) use pandas default skipna=True semantics. Missing values are excluded from statistics. The dashboard does NOT call fillna(), impute(), drop rows, or substitute missing values to make charts appear cleaner.
policy.rationale: Filling or dropping missing values in a student research dataset would misrepresent data quality and bias aggregations.

per_field_policy.release_year: exclude missing years from aggregation (null_count: 0 per confirmed source)
per_field_policy.audio_features: exclude null from mean aggregation; report null_count in captions
